question: Apart from Gujarat, Jiviti (Jivti/Jivati) Puja is performed by married women, mainly in the state/union territory of _____.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Jivati puja is celebrated in the states of **Gujarat and Maharashtra**.
 
• It is celebrated in the month of **Shravan(July-August)**.
 
• Puja is performed by married women mainly.
 
• Jivti is an** incarnation of Parvati**, a goddess
